title: STARTEX: Overnight Desk, NLTO Primary Control Room

fields.location: Northern Lakes Transmission Operations (NLTO) primary control room, Duluth, Minnesota
fields.weather: Clear and calm, minus 9 °C, light wind off Lake Superior.
fields.load: 2,240 MW, the overnight low. Today's daily peak is expected to reach about 2,900 MW.
fields.staffing: Night shift: one Control Room Shift Supervisor on the desk. Reliability Engineer Dr. Imani Okeke is on call from home.
fields.narration: STARTEX. THIS IS AN EXERCISE. It is 02:00 Central time, 08:00 UTC, on Tuesday, March 16, 2027, in the NLTO primary control room in Duluth. One Control Room Shift Supervisor is on the desk, and the reliability engineer, Dr. Imani Okeke, is on call from home. Taconite Ridge, Lake Superior Hydro and Baraga Wind are on line, all 345 kV lines are in service, and EMS, SCADA, the state estimator and the PMU wide-area screen are normal. The supervisor's log has one overnight entry: at 22:30 Central on Wednesday (04:30 UTC Thursday), an EXERCISE SWPC Geomagnetic Storm Watch, message code WATA50, arrived for today, Thursday, at G3 (Strong). It was logged and no other action was taken. Six planned 345 kV outages are booked for today, the Duluth Harbor Terminal hotline is quiet, and system status is NORMAL.

status.name: System load and generation
status.note: 2,240 MW. Taconite Ridge, Lake Superior Hydro and Baraga Wind Farm on line.

status.name: Arrowhead and North Shore interfaces
status.note: Arrowhead import 610 MW of a 1,000 MW limit. North Shore import 340 MW of a 600 MW limit.

status.name: 345 kV network and reactive devices
status.note: All 345 kV lines in service. Cloquet SVC and the Iron Range and Hartley capacitor banks are off line.

status.name: Planned work today
status.note: Six planned 345 kV outages are booked for today's shift.

status.name: Space weather
status.note: EXERCISE WATA50 G3 watch for Thursday, logged at 22:30 Central. Action field is blank.

status.name: EMS / SCADA / state estimator / PMU
status.note: All normal.

status.name: Substation timing
status.note: All 14 GPS-disciplined substation clocks are locked.

fields.facilitatorNote: This card is dated with the exercise date, Tuesday, March 16, 2027. Central time is CST (UTC−6) on that date, so the watch entry reads 04:30 UTC. If later injects show CDT or March 2027 dates, tell the room that the controlling clock is the one on this card. Give each table a copy of the NGDOP section 3 log format before you read.
fields.scenarioTitle: Aurora Over Texas — GIC, Conservative Operations & Timing Holdover

instructorNote: This card sets the baseline. Watch whether the CRSS checks the WATA50 log entry against NGDOP 3, which requires the code, the UTC and Central times and the action taken, and notices that the action field is blank. Also watch whether anyone brings up the six planned 345 kV outages against the G3 watch.
